A delicious, healthy pasta in roasted tomato sauce that’s a refreshing change from your usual white and red sauces!
Charred tomatoes, onion and garlic are blended into a smooth, flavourful sauce, then cooked with cream cheese and loads of fresh basil to create a pasta that’s creamy, comforting and absolutely incredible.
Do give this one a try, and as always, the full written recipe is below.Happy Cooking!
